record.question: A white elephant
record.explanation: Answer D: a costly but useless thing. A white elephant is something costly to maintain and of little or no use (D). Independent check: A white elephant is a possession that is costly to maintain and of little practical use. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/white-elephant.
